curated-dafont-whitin-gf-noto-serif-jp: Noto Serif JP is a text serif with a faintly modulated line. Whitin swells its verticals fat and lets hairlines vanish, so it's a loud headline voice (say, an art fair booth banner), not one for long paragraphs.
curated-dafont-woodgod-general-sans: Vintage swagger first: Woodgod's tall lowercase nearly meets its capitals, which would suit, say, a western ranch label. Woodgod commands attention up top; General Sans keeps the text moving smoothly.
curated-dafont-woodgod-gf-graduate: Woodgod looks vintage and commanding, with a wide channel into every bowl. It does the loud work, while Graduate, a text serif with generous spacing and no stem-to-join contrast, handles the quieter reading.
curated-dafont-zag-fs-quicksand: Zag is bold and tightly tracked, with oversized-looking small letters. Quicksand, a sans with round, bulb-like bowls, shares that build, so both would sit comfortably on, a gym membership flyer.
curated-dafont-zombie-holocaust-gf-ibm-p: Uppercase letters of constant thickness, stitched so tightly they nearly overlap, make Zombie Holocaust dense (for a stack overflow style q&a, say). IBM Plex Mono gives that crush some room, though neither suits long paragraphs.
curated-fredoka-gf-im-fell-dw-pica-sc: Friendly Fredoka keeps a single line width with an open e (say, for a cute bakery's identity). But IM Fell DW Pica SC is the bookish one, with moderate stroke modulation, neither wispy nor heavy.
curated-fredoka-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Friendly and uniform in line: that is Fredoka at its simplest. Nanum Myeongjo, a text serif with quiet modulation and curve tips that never touch, makes the real contrast.
curated-fredoka-gf-tiro-bangla: Fredoka is friendly and approachable, with letters drawn at a single constant line width and an open e. Tiro Bangla's bold stems feel traditional, not made for long paragraphs.
curated-fs-array-bitter: Futuristic and precise, Array keeps its curves open-ended and its lowercase eyes large. Bitter, a grounded slab-serif with a see-through s, stays dependable across a page, though it was made for brief sittings.
curated-fs-array-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display is an approachable sans with a tall middle zone, backing Array's futuristic headings (a racing game ui, say). Read at length, it stays approachable but is really made for brief stretches.
